string-array.name: guide_bench_press_steps
string-array.item: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar. Pull your shoulder blades together and down, feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders, unrack it and hold it over your shoulders with straight arms.
Inhale and lower the bar to your lower chest, elbows at about 45° to your torso.
Exhale and press the bar up without lifting your hips or shoulder blades off the bench.

string-array.name: guide_bench_press_mistakes
string-array.item: Hips lifting off the bench
Elbows flared to 90°, shifting the load to the shoulders
Bouncing the bar off the chest

string-array.name: guide_incline_bench_press_steps
string-array.item: Set the bench to 30–45°. Retract your shoulder blades and plant your feet.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders and unrack it over your upper chest.
Lower the bar to your upper chest, keeping elbows under the bar.
Press up along a slight arc.

string-array.name: guide_incline_bench_press_mistakes
string-array.item: Too steep an incline turns it into a shoulder press
Lowering the bar to mid chest or the neck
Arching hard and sliding the hips off the bench

string-array.name: guide_decline_bench_press_steps
string-array.item: Hook your legs under the pads of a decline bench and retract your shoulder blades.
Unrack the bar with a spotter or carefully on your own.
Lower the bar to your lower chest under control.
Press up until your arms are almost straight.

string-array.name: guide_decline_bench_press_mistakes
string-array.item: Going heavy without a spotter
Lowering the bar towards the neck
Dropping fast and bouncing off the chest

string-array.name: guide_dumbbell_bench_press_steps
string-array.item: Sit with the dumbbells on your thighs, lie back and bring them over your chest.
Retract your shoulder blades, palms facing your feet or slightly inwards.
Lower the dumbbells beside your chest to a light stretch.
Press up, bringing them slightly together over your chest.

string-array.name: guide_dumbbell_bench_press_mistakes
string-array.item: Clanging the dumbbells together at the top
Going too deep and losing control
One arm pressing faster than the other

string-array.name: guide_incline_dumbbell_press_steps
string-array.item: Set the bench to 30–45°, rest the dumbbells on your thighs and lie back.
Bring them over your upper chest and retract your shoulder blades.
Lower them to your upper chest, elbows slightly below shoulder level.
Press up along an arc without knocking them together.

string-array.name: guide_incline_dumbbell_press_mistakes
string-array.item: Elbows flared straight out to the sides
Shoulder blades lifting off the bench at the top
Bench set too steep

string-array.name: guide_dumbbell_fly_steps
string-array.item: Lie on the bench with the dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep that angle.
Open your arms in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Bring the dumbbells back along the same arc, squeezing the chest.

string-array.name: guide_dumbbell_fly_mistakes
string-array.item: Bending the arms so the fly becomes a press
Weights too heavy for the shoulder joint
Lowering below the bench

string-array.name: guide_cable_crossover_steps
string-array.item: Stand between the pulleys holding the handles, step forward and lean slightly.
Keep a soft bend in the elbows and the chest open.
Bring the handles together in front of you in an arc, squeezing the chest.
Slowly return your arms to the sides until you feel a stretch.

string-array.name: guide_cable_crossover_mistakes
string-array.item: Swinging the torso to move the weight
Shrugging the shoulders
Letting the handles snap back

string-array.name: guide_chest_press_machine_steps
string-array.item: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid chest height.
Keep your back and shoulder blades against the pad.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return them slowly to a light chest stretch.

string-array.name: guide_chest_press_machine_mistakes
string-array.item: Seat too high or too low
Shoulder blades leaving the pad
Locking the elbows hard

string-array.name: guide_push_up_steps
string-array.item: Get into a high plank, hands slightly wider than shoulders, body straight from head to heels.
Brace your abs and glutes.
Lower until your chest nearly touches the floor, elbows at 45° to your torso.
Push back up keeping the body in one line.

string-array.name: guide_push_up_mistakes
string-array.item: Hips sagging or piking up
Partial range of motion
Head dropping before the chest

string-array.name: guide_deadlift_steps
string-array.item: Stand with the bar over mid foot, feet hip width apart.
Hinge down with a flat back and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Tighten your back, set your hips and take a breath.
Push the floor away and drag the bar up your legs, finishing fully upright.

string-array.name: guide_deadlift_mistakes
string-array.item: Rounded lower back
Bar drifting away from the legs
Leaning back too far at lockout

string-array.name: guide_pull_up_steps
string-array.item: Grab the bar overhand slightly wider than shoulders and hang with straight arms.
Pull your shoulders down and back.
Pull up, driving the elbows down, until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself slowly to straight arms.

string-array.name: guide_pull_up_mistakes
string-array.item: Kipping and swinging
Not straightening the arms at the bottom
Shrugging the shoulders up

string-array.name: guide_chin_up_steps
string-array.item: Grab the bar underhand at shoulder width.
Hang with straight arms and brace your core.
Pull up until your chin is over the bar.
Lower slowly.

string-array.name: guide_chin_up_mistakes
string-array.item: Swinging the legs for momentum
Stopping short at the bottom
A grip so narrow it strains the wrists

string-array.name: guide_lat_pulldown_steps
string-array.item: Sit with your thighs under the pads and take a wide grip.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving the elbows down and back.
Let the bar rise slowly to straight arms.

string-array.name: guide_lat_pulldown_mistakes
string-array.item: Pulling behind the neck
Leaning far back and using body weight
Pulling with the biceps instead of the back

string-array.name: guide_barbell_row_steps
string-array.item: Grip the bar at shoulder width and hinge forward with a flat back almost to parallel.
Keep your knees soft and the bar hanging under your shoulders.
Row the bar to your lower stomach, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Lower it under control without changing your angle.

string-array.name: guide_barbell_row_mistakes
string-array.item: Rounded back
Standing up more with every rep
Jerking the weight with the legs and lower back

string-array.name: guide_dumbbell_row_steps
string-array.item: Put one knee and hand on a bench, back flat and parallel to the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in the free hand with the arm straight.
Row it to your hip, keeping the elbow close to your side.
Lower until the arm is straight again.

string-array.name: guide_dumbbell_row_mistakes
string-array.item: Twisting the torso to lift the weight
Rowing to the chest instead of the hip
Partial range of motion

string-array.name: guide_seated_cable_row_steps
string-array.item: Sit with your feet braced, grab the handle and keep your back straight.
Bend your knees slightly and keep the shoulders down.
Pull the handle to your stomach, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Extend your arms forward without rounding your back.

string-array.name: guide_seated_cable_row_mistakes
string-array.item: Rocking the torso back and forth
Rounding the lower back at the front
Shrugging the shoulders

string-array.name: guide_t_bar_row_steps
string-array.item: Straddle the bar and hinge forward with a flat back, knees soft.
Grab the handle with straight arms.
Row the bar to your lower chest, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Lower under control, keeping the hinge.

string-array.name: guide_t_bar_row_mistakes
string-array.item: Rounded back
Standing up instead of rowing
Heavy weight with a shortened range

string-array.name: guide_hyperextension_steps
string-array.item: Set the pad under the top of your thighs with your feet secured.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your back straight.
Lower your torso by bending at the hips.
Rise to a straight line, squeezing your glutes.

string-array.name: guide_hyperextension_mistakes
string-array.item: Overarching the lower back at the top
Swinging with momentum
Pad set too high, limiting the hinge

string-array.name: guide_shrug_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall holding a barbell or dumbbells at your sides.
Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower your shoulders slowly.

string-array.name: guide_shrug_mistakes
string-array.item: Rolling the shoulders in circles
Bending the elbows
Weight so heavy the range is tiny

string-array.name: guide_overhead_press_steps
string-array.item: Hold the bar on your upper chest slightly wider than shoulders, elbows a little in front.
Brace your abs and glutes, legs straight.
Press the bar overhead, moving your head back and then through under the bar.
Lower it back to your chest under control.

string-array.name: guide_overhead_press_mistakes
string-array.item: Heavy arch in the lower back
Dipping and driving with the legs
Bar drifting forward of the mid foot

string-array.name: guide_dumbbell_shoulder_press_steps
string-array.item: Sit on an upright bench with the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Keep your back against the pad, palms forward.
Press the dumbbells up, bringing them slightly together overhead.
Lower them to ear level.

string-array.name: guide_dumbbell_shoulder_press_mistakes
string-array.item: Arching off the backrest
Lowering the dumbbells too far
Clanging them at the top

string-array.name: guide_arnold_press_steps
string-array.item: Sit holding the dumbbells in front of your chin, palms facing you.
Start pressing up while rotating your palms forward.
Straighten your arms overhead.
Lower with the reverse rotation back to the start.

string-array.name: guide_arnold_press_mistakes
string-array.item: Rotating and pressing as separate moves
Arching the lower back
Rushing the tempo

string-array.name: guide_lateral_raise_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall with the dumbbells at your thighs, elbows slightly bent.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lead with the elbows, keeping the hands no higher than them.
Lower the dumbbells slowly.

string-array.name: guide_lateral_raise_mistakes
string-array.item: Swinging the torso
Raising above the shoulders and shrugging
Dumbbells too heavy

string-array.name: guide_front_raise_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall with the dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Raise one or both arms forward to shoulder height.
Keep the elbows soft and the torso still.
Lower under control.

string-array.name: guide_front_raise_mistakes
string-array.item: Leaning back to swing the weight
Raising above eye level
Dropping the dumbbells

string-array.name: guide_rear_delt_fly_steps
string-array.item: Hinge forward with a flat back, dumbbells under your chest.
Bend your elbows slightly.
Raise your arms out to the sides to torso level without fully squeezing the shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

string-array.name: guide_rear_delt_fly_mistakes
string-array.item: Using the upper back instead of the rear delts
Lifting the torso while raising
Weight too heavy

string-array.name: guide_face_pull_steps
string-array.item: Set the pulley at face height and grab the rope overhand.
Step back with your arms extended.
Pull the rope to your face, spreading the ends and elbows apart.
Return your arms forward slowly.

string-array.name: guide_face_pull_mistakes
string-array.item: Pulling to the chest instead of the face
Leaning back
Elbows lower than the hands

string-array.name: guide_upright_row_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall holding the bar with a grip a little narrower than shoulders.
Raise the bar along your body, leading with the elbows out and up.
Stop when the elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower under control.

string-array.name: guide_upright_row_mistakes
string-array.item: A very narrow grip and pulling above the shoulders, which strains the joint
Jerking with the torso
Bar drifting away from the body

string-array.name: guide_barbell_curl_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall holding the bar underhand at shoulder width.
Pin your elbows to your sides.
Curl the bar up towards your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

string-array.name: guide_barbell_curl_mistakes
string-array.item: Swinging the torso
Elbows drifting forward
Dropping the bar without control

string-array.name: guide_dumbbell_curl_steps
string-array.item: Stand or sit with the dumbbells hanging at your sides.
Keep the elbows close to your body.
Curl up while turning your palms to face up.
Lower under control.

string-array.name: guide_dumbbell_curl_mistakes
string-array.item: Heaving the weight with the torso
Elbows moving forward and back
Not straightening the arms at the bottom

string-array.name: guide_hammer_curl_steps
string-array.item: Hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip, palms facing each other.
Keep the elbows at your sides.
Curl up without rotating your wrists.
Lower slowly.

string-array.name: guide_hammer_curl_mistakes
string-array.item: Swinging the torso
Rotating the wrists during the curl
Elbows leaving the sides

string-array.name: guide_preacher_curl_steps
string-array.item: Sit at the preacher bench with your upper arms flat on the pad.
Hold a bar or dumbbell underhand.
Curl to the top.
Lower until your arms are almost straight, staying tight at the bottom.

string-array.name: guide_preacher_curl_mistakes
string-array.item: Elbows lifting off the pad
Dropping into locked elbows
Weight too heavy

string-array.name: guide_cable_curl_steps
string-array.item: Face a low pulley and take the handle underhand.
Keep the elbows at your sides.
Curl up to your shoulders.
Lower the handle smoothly.

string-array.name: guide_cable_curl_mistakes
string-array.item: Leaning back
Elbows drifting forward
Partial range of motion

string-array.name: guide_close_grip_bench_press_steps
string-array.item: Lie on the bench and grip the bar at shoulder width.
Retract your shoulder blades and keep the elbows close to your body.
Lower the bar to your lower chest.
Press up using your triceps.

string-array.name: guide_close_grip_bench_press_mistakes
string-array.item: A grip so narrow it strains the wrists
Elbows flaring out
Bouncing the bar off the chest

string-array.name: guide_triceps_pushdown_steps
string-array.item: Stand at a high pulley holding the handle, elbows pinned to your sides.
Lean forward slightly.
Push the handle down until your arms are straight.
Let it rise to chest level without moving your elbows.

string-array.name: guide_triceps_pushdown_mistakes
string-array.item: Elbows leaving the sides
Using the torso and shoulders
Letting the handle rise too high

string-array.name: guide_skull_crusher_steps
string-array.item: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar over your chest with straight arms.
Fix your upper arms, tilted slightly towards your head.
Bend the elbows to lower the bar to your forehead or behind your head.
Extend your arms without moving the upper arms.

string-array.name: guide_skull_crusher_mistakes
string-array.item: Elbows flaring out
Moving the shoulders instead of only the elbows
Weight too heavy to control near the head

string-array.name: guide_overhead_triceps_extension_steps
string-array.item: Sit or stand holding a dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Point the elbows forward, close to your head.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbows.
Extend your arms back up.

string-array.name: guide_overhead_triceps_extension_mistakes
string-array.item: Elbows flaring out
Arching the lower back
Partial range of motion

string-array.name: guide_dips_steps
string-array.item: Support yourself on the bars with straight arms.
Lean forward for chest or stay upright for triceps.
Lower until your shoulders are slightly below your elbows.
Press back up to straight arms.

string-array.name: guide_dips_mistakes
string-array.item: Going so deep the shoulders hurt
Swinging the legs
Shrugging the shoulders

string-array.name: guide_wrist_curl_steps
string-array.item: Sit with your forearms on your thighs or a bench, hands hanging over.
Hold a bar or dumbbells palms up.
Curl your wrists to lift the weight.
Lower slowly.

string-array.name: guide_wrist_curl_mistakes
string-array.item: Moving the forearms
Weight too heavy
Jerky reps

string-array.name: guide_squat_steps
string-array.item: Rest the bar on your upper traps, feet slightly wider than shoulders, toes turned out a little.
Take a breath and brace your core.
Sit back and down with your knees tracking over your toes.
Go to parallel or below and stand up, pushing through the whole foot.

string-array.name: guide_squat_mistakes
string-array.item: Knees caving in
Heels lifting off the floor
Lower back rounding at the bottom

string-array.name: guide_front_squat_steps
string-array.item: Rest the bar on your front delts with the elbows high.
Feet at shoulder width, torso upright.
Squat deep, keeping the elbows up.
Stand up with the torso staying upright.

string-array.name: guide_front_squat_mistakes
string-array.item: Elbows dropping so the bar rolls forward
Leaning the torso forward
Heels lifting off the floor

string-array.name: guide_hack_squat_steps
string-array.item: Step into the machine with your back and shoulders against the pads.
Place your feet on the platform at shoulder width.
Lower until your knees reach 90° or deeper.
Press back up without snapping the knees straight.

string-array.name: guide_hack_squat_mistakes
string-array.item: Knees caving in
Hips leaving the back pad
Locking the knees at the top

string-array.name: guide_leg_press_steps
string-array.item: Sit with your back and hips against the seat, feet on the platform at shoulder width.
Release the safety catches.
Lower the platform until your knees are at about 90°.
Press it back up without locking your knees.

string-array.name: guide_leg_press_mistakes
string-array.item: Hips rolling off the seat at the bottom
Knees caving in
Locking the knees at the top

string-array.name: guide_leg_extension_steps
string-array.item: Sit with the pad on your lower shins and your knees at the edge of the seat.
Hold the handles.
Extend your legs until they are almost straight.
Lower slowly.

string-array.name: guide_leg_extension_mistakes
string-array.item: Kicking and dropping the weight
Hips lifting off the seat
Pad set in the wrong position

string-array.name: guide_lunge_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall holding dumbbells or with a bar on your back.
Take a long step forward.
Lower until your back knee almost touches the floor.
Push off the front foot to return to the start.

string-array.name: guide_lunge_mistakes
string-array.item: Front knee caving in
Step too short, pushing the knee far past the toes
Leaning the torso forward

string-array.name: guide_bulgarian_split_squat_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your back to a bench and rest the top of your rear foot on it.
Place the front foot a long stride ahead.
Lower until the front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Stand up by driving through the front foot.

string-array.name: guide_bulgarian_split_squat_mistakes
string-array.item: Front foot too close to the bench
Knee caving in
Pushing with the rear leg

string-array.name: guide_romanian_deadlift_steps
string-array.item: Stand holding the bar at shoulder width, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and hinge with a flat back.
Slide the bar down your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.

string-array.name: guide_romanian_deadlift_mistakes
string-array.item: Rounding the back
Bending the knees so it becomes a regular deadlift
Bar drifting away from the legs

string-array.name: guide_leg_curl_steps
string-array.item: Lie or sit in the machine with the pad above your heels.
Keep your knees just past the edge of the pad.
Curl the pad towards your glutes.
Extend slowly.

string-array.name: guide_leg_curl_mistakes
string-array.item: Hips lifting off the bench
Jerky reps
Partial range of motion

string-array.name: guide_good_morning_steps
string-array.item: Rest the bar on your traps, feet at shoulder width, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and hinge with a flat back.
Lower until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Rise by squeezing your glutes and hamstrings.

string-array.name: guide_good_morning_mistakes
string-array.item: Rounding the lower back
Using too much weight
Bending the knees instead of hinging

string-array.name: guide_hip_thrust_steps
string-array.item: Sit on the floor with your shoulder blades against a bench and the bar over your hips.
Feet at shoulder width, knees bent.
Drive your hips up to a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower.

string-array.name: guide_hip_thrust_mistakes
string-array.item: Overarching the lower back at the top
Feet too far or too close
Throwing the head back

string-array.name: guide_glute_bridge_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with your feet near your hips and knees bent.
Arms rest along your sides.
Lift your hips, squeezing your glutes.
Lower without fully resting on the floor.

string-array.name: guide_glute_bridge_mistakes
string-array.item: Arching the lower back
Pushing through the toes instead of the heels
Knees falling apart

string-array.name: guide_cable_kickback_steps
string-array.item: Attach the cuff to your ankle and face the low pulley.
Lean forward slightly and hold the frame.
Kick your leg back, squeezing the glute.
Return under control.

string-array.name: guide_cable_kickback_mistakes
string-array.item: Arching the lower back instead of using the glute
Swinging the torso
Weight too heavy

string-array.name: guide_standing_calf_raise_steps
string-array.item: Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of a step, heels hanging.
Keep your legs straight.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels below the step to a stretch.

string-array.name: guide_standing_calf_raise_mistakes
string-array.item: Bouncing with a short range
Bending the knees
Rushing the tempo

string-array.name: guide_seated_calf_raise_steps
string-array.item: Sit in the machine with the pad on your thighs near the knees.
Place the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform.
Rise onto your toes.
Lower your heels to a stretch.

string-array.name: guide_seated_calf_raise_mistakes
string-array.item: Partial range of motion
Jerky reps
Rolling onto the toes

string-array.name: guide_crunch_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hands behind your head or on your chest.
Lift your shoulders off the floor, curling your ribs towards your hips.
Lower under control.

string-array.name: guide_crunch_mistakes
string-array.item: Pulling the head with your hands
Sitting all the way up with the hip flexors
Jerky reps

string-array.name: guide_cable_crunch_steps
string-array.item: Kneel at a high pulley holding the rope by your head.
Keep your hips still.
Crunch down, bringing your ribs towards your hips.
Return up under control.

string-array.name: guide_cable_crunch_mistakes
string-array.item: Moving the hips
Pulling with the arms
Weight too heavy

string-array.name: guide_hanging_leg_raise_steps
string-array.item: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Brace your abs with your legs together.
Raise your legs to parallel or higher, curling your pelvis up.
Lower slowly without swinging.

string-array.name: guide_hanging_leg_raise_mistakes
string-array.item: Swinging the body
Lifting only with the hip flexors without curling the pelvis
Dropping the legs

string-array.name: guide_russian_twist_steps
string-array.item: Sit on the floor, lean back with your knees bent.
Hold a weight in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso side to side, touching the weight to the floor.
Keep your back straight.

string-array.name: guide_russian_twist_mistakes
string-array.item: Turning only the arms
Rounded back
Rushing the tempo

string-array.name: guide_ab_wheel_steps
string-array.item: Kneel holding the wheel under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and glutes.
Roll the wheel forward, keeping your back flat.
Pull back using your abs.

string-array.name: guide_ab_wheel_mistakes
string-array.item: Lower back sagging
Rolling out further than you can control
Hips rising first on the way back

string-array.name: guide_plank_steps
string-array.item: Rest on your forearms with the elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Brace your abs and glutes.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.

string-array.name: guide_plank_mistakes
string-array.item: Hips sagging
Hips piked up
Holding your breath

string-array.name: guide_running_steps
string-array.item: Warm up with 5–10 minutes of walking or easy jogging.
Keep your torso upright and shoulders relaxed.
Land under your centre of mass with short, quick steps.
Walk for a few minutes to cool down.

string-array.name: guide_running_mistakes
string-array.item: Overstriding and landing hard on the heel
Starting fast without a warm-up
Tense shoulders and arms

string-array.name: guide_cycling_steps
string-array.item: Set the saddle so your leg is almost straight at the bottom of the stroke.
Keep your back neutral and arms relaxed.
Pedal smoothly.
Adjust the resistance to hold your target pace.

string-array.name: guide_cycling_mistakes
string-array.item: Saddle too low, straining the knees
Rocking the torso
Resistance too high

string-array.name: guide_rowing_machine_steps
string-array.item: Strap in your feet, take the handle and keep your back straight.
Start the stroke by pushing with your legs.
Then lean back slightly and pull the handle to your stomach.
Return in reverse order: arms, torso, legs.

string-array.name: guide_rowing_machine_mistakes
string-array.item: Pulling with the arms and skipping the legs
Rounded back
Bending the knees before the arms go forward

string-array.name: guide_elliptical_steps
string-array.item: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles.
Keep your torso upright.
Move smoothly, working arms and legs together.
Set the resistance for your target heart rate.

string-array.name: guide_elliptical_mistakes
string-array.item: Leaning on the handles
Slouching
Resistance too light

string-array.name: guide_stair_climber_steps
string-array.item: Step on and hold the rails lightly.
Keep your torso upright.
Step with your whole foot.
Keep a steady pace.

string-array.name: guide_stair_climber_mistakes
string-array.item: Hanging on the rails
Stepping only on the toes
Slouching

string-array.name: guide_jump_rope_steps
string-array.item: Check the length: the handles should reach your armpits.
Turn the rope with your wrists, elbows close to your body.
Jump low on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.

string-array.name: guide_jump_rope_mistakes
string-array.item: Jumping too high
Turning the rope with the whole arm
Landing on the heels

string-array.name: guide_pec_deck_steps
string-array.item: Sit with your back against the pad and the handles at chest height.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep that angle.
Exhale and bring the handles together in front of your chest, squeezing for a second.
Slowly open your arms until you feel a light stretch in the chest.

string-array.name: guide_pec_deck_mistakes
string-array.item: Shoulders rolling forward and up
Opening too wide with pain in the shoulders
Jerking and banging the weight stack

string-array.name: guide_incline_dumbbell_fly_steps
string-array.item: Lie on a bench inclined at 30–45°, dumbbells over your chest, palms facing each other.
Bend your elbows slightly and keep that angle.
Inhale and lower the dumbbells in an arc until your chest stretches.
Exhale and bring them back along the same arc.

string-array.name: guide_incline_dumbbell_fly_mistakes
string-array.item: Bending the arms so the fly turns into a press
Lowering the dumbbells below shoulder level
Going too heavy

string-array.name: guide_smith_incline_press_steps
string-array.item: Set the bench at 30° so the bar comes down to your upper chest.
Pull your shoulder blades together, feet on the floor, grip slightly wider than shoulders.
Unhook the bar by turning your wrists and lower it to your chest.
Press up without snapping your elbows straight.

string-array.name: guide_smith_incline_press_mistakes
string-array.item: Bench placed so the bar travels to the neck
Shoulder blades not set
Bouncing the bar off the chest

string-array.name: guide_chest_dip_steps
string-array.item: Support yourself on the bars, knees bent and ankles crossed.
Lean your torso forward about 30°, elbows slightly out.
Lower until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Press back up keeping the forward lean.

string-array.name: guide_chest_dip_mistakes
string-array.item: Going too deep with pain in the shoulders
Upright torso that shifts the work to the triceps
Swinging the legs

string-array.name: guide_dumbbell_pullover_steps
string-array.item: Lie across or along a bench holding one dumbbell with both hands over your chest.
Bend your elbows slightly and lock them there.
Inhale and lower the dumbbell behind your head until the chest and lats stretch.
Exhale and bring it back over your chest.

string-array.name: guide_dumbbell_pullover_mistakes
string-array.item: Bending and straightening the elbows so the triceps do the work
Lowering the dumbbell too far
Arching the lower back hard

string-array.name: guide_close_grip_pulldown_steps
string-array.item: Take the V-handle, sit down and lock your thighs under the pads.
Lean back slightly with your chest up.
Pull the handle to your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades and driving the elbows down.
Return slowly and let your lats stretch.

string-array.name: guide_close_grip_pulldown_mistakes
string-array.item: Pulling with body swing
Shoulders creeping up to the ears
Cutting the range short at the top

string-array.name: guide_straight_arm_pulldown_steps
string-array.item: Face a high pulley, take a straight bar or rope and hinge slightly forward.
Keep your arms almost straight with a soft bend in the elbows.
Sweep the handle down to your thighs using your lats.
Slowly return your arms to head height.

string-array.name: guide_straight_arm_pulldown_mistakes
string-array.item: Bending the elbows so the triceps take over
Swinging the torso
Shrugging the shoulders up

string-array.name: guide_inverted_row_steps
string-array.item: Set a bar at waist height, lie under it and grip slightly wider than shoulders.
Keep your body straight from heels to head with glutes tight.
Pull your chest to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower yourself smoothly to straight arms.

string-array.name: guide_inverted_row_mistakes
string-array.item: Hips sagging
Reaching with the chin
Jerking instead of pulling

string-array.name: guide_chest_supported_row_steps
string-array.item: Lie chest down on a bench inclined at 30–45°, dumbbells hanging below.
Keep your neck neutral and chest on the pad.
Row the dumbbells to your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.

string-array.name: guide_chest_supported_row_mistakes
string-array.item: Chest lifting off the bench
Rowing to the shoulders instead of the waist
Short range of motion

string-array.name: guide_machine_row_steps
string-array.item: Sit with your chest against the pad and take the handles.
Keep your back straight and shoulders down.
Pull the handles in, squeezing your shoulder blades and driving the elbows back.
Return slowly and let the shoulder blades spread.

string-array.name: guide_machine_row_mistakes
string-array.item: Chest leaving the pad
Pulling with the arms only
Letting the weight drop back

string-array.name: guide_machine_shoulder_press_steps
string-array.item: Set the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Keep your back against the pad and feet on the floor.
Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower them slowly to shoulder level.

string-array.name: guide_machine_shoulder_press_mistakes
string-array.item: Lower back leaving the pad
Snapping the elbows straight
Short range at the bottom

string-array.name: guide_cable_lateral_raise_steps
string-array.item: Stand side-on to a low pulley and take the handle in the far hand.
Keep a soft bend in the elbow and lean slightly away from the stack.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly without letting the weight drop.

string-array.name: guide_cable_lateral_raise_mistakes
string-array.item: Raising above the shoulder so the traps take over
Swinging the body
Bending the arm more as you lift

string-array.name: guide_reverse_pec_deck_steps
string-array.item: Sit facing the pad with the handles at shoulder height.
Keep your arms almost straight with a slight bend.
Open your arms back using the rear delts.
Bring them forward slowly.

string-array.name: guide_reverse_pec_deck_mistakes
string-array.item: Squeezing the shoulder blades instead of using the shoulders
Jerking
Too much weight and a short range

string-array.name: guide_pike_push_up_steps
string-array.item: Start in a push-up position and raise your hips into an upside-down V.
Hands slightly wider than shoulders, head between the arms.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Press back to the start.

string-array.name: guide_pike_push_up_mistakes
string-array.item: Hips dropping so it becomes a regular push-up
Elbows flaring wide
Bumping the head on the floor

string-array.name: guide_ez_bar_curl_steps
string-array.item: Take the EZ bar by the angled grips and stand tall.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up to your chest.
Lower it slowly until your arms are almost straight.

string-array.name: guide_ez_bar_curl_mistakes
string-array.item: Elbows drifting forward
Swinging the body
Dropping the bar without control

string-array.name: guide_incline_dumbbell_curl_steps
string-array.item: Sit on a bench inclined at 45–60° with the dumbbells hanging down.
Keep your upper arms still, palms forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly to a full biceps stretch.

string-array.name: guide_incline_dumbbell_curl_mistakes
string-array.item: Upper arms swinging forward
Head and torso coming off the bench
Going too heavy

string-array.name: guide_concentration_curl_steps
string-array.item: Sit on a bench and brace the working elbow against your inner thigh.
Let the dumbbell hang, palm facing away from the thigh.
Curl it up toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly until the arm is almost straight.

string-array.name: guide_concentration_curl_mistakes
string-array.item: Elbow leaving the thigh
Helping with the torso
Not lowering fully

string-array.name: guide_machine_curl_steps
string-array.item: Set the seat so your elbows rest on the pad in line with the machine pivot.
Take the handles and keep your back straight.
Curl until the biceps are fully contracted.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

string-array.name: guide_machine_curl_mistakes
string-array.item: Shoulders lifting off the pad
Jerking
Short range of motion

string-array.name: guide_rope_pushdown_steps
string-array.item: Face a high pulley, take the rope and pin your elbows to your sides.
Lean slightly forward and keep your torso still.
Push the rope down and spread the ends apart at the bottom.
Return slowly to a right angle at the elbows.

string-array.name: guide_rope_pushdown_mistakes
string-array.item: Elbows moving forward and back
Leaning into the weight
Not locking out fully

string-array.name: guide_dumbbell_kickback_steps
string-array.item: Brace one hand and knee on a bench with your back parallel to the floor.
Keep the working upper arm by your side, elbow bent at 90°.
Straighten your arm back.
Lower the dumbbell slowly.

string-array.name: guide_dumbbell_kickback_mistakes
string-array.item: Upper arm dropping so it becomes a swing
Going too heavy
Rounding the back

string-array.name: guide_bench_dip_steps
string-array.item: Sit on the edge of a bench, hands next to your hips, and slide your hips forward.
Keep your legs bent or straight and your back close to the bench.
Bend your elbows back and lower until they reach a right angle.
Straighten your arms to rise.

string-array.name: guide_bench_dip_mistakes
string-array.item: Going too deep with pain in the shoulders
Elbows flaring out
Back drifting away from the bench

string-array.name: guide_diamond_push_up_steps
string-array.item: Get into a push-up position with your hands forming a triangle under your chest.
Keep your body straight, abs and glutes tight.
Lower your chest to your hands with the elbows close to your body.
Press back up.

string-array.name: guide_diamond_push_up_mistakes
string-array.item: Hips sagging
Elbows flaring out
Not lowering far enough

string-array.name: guide_cable_overhead_extension_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your back to the pulley, take the rope overhead and step forward.
Keep your elbows by your head and pointing forward.
Extend your arms forward and up until straight.
Slowly return the rope behind your head.

string-array.name: guide_cable_overhead_extension_mistakes
string-array.item: Elbows flaring out
Arching the lower back
Moving the shoulders instead of the elbows

string-array.name: guide_reverse_wrist_curl_steps
string-array.item: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench, palms down.
Let your wrists hang over the edge, grip at shoulder width.
Lift your hands by extending the wrists.
Lower slowly.

string-array.name: guide_reverse_wrist_curl_mistakes
string-array.item: Too much weight and jerking
Forearms lifting off the support
Short range of motion

string-array.name: guide_reverse_curl_steps
string-array.item: Grip the bar overhand at shoulder width and stand tall.
Keep your elbows at your sides and wrists straight.
Curl the bar up to your chest.
Lower it slowly.

string-array.name: guide_reverse_curl_mistakes
string-array.item: Wrists bending back
Swinging the body
Elbows drifting forward

string-array.name: guide_dead_hang_steps
string-array.item: Grip the bar overhand at shoulder width.
Hang on straight arms with your feet off the floor.
Keep your shoulders slightly engaged instead of sinking into the joints.
Hold for the set time and breathe steadily.

string-array.name: guide_dead_hang_mistakes
string-array.item: Swinging
Letting the shoulders go completely loose
Holding your breath

string-array.name: guide_farmers_walk_steps
string-array.item: Pick up heavy dumbbells or kettlebells and stand tall.
Keep your shoulders down and back and your abs tight.
Walk with short quick steps without swaying.
Set the weight down without rounding your back.

string-array.name: guide_farmers_walk_mistakes
string-array.item: Leaning to one side
Shoulders creeping up
Lifting and setting down with a rounded back

string-array.name: guide_goblet_squat_steps
string-array.item: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell upright at your chest, feet slightly wider than shoulders.
Chest up, elbows pointing down.
Squat down, pushing your knees out in line with your toes.
Stand up driving through the whole foot.

string-array.name: guide_goblet_squat_mistakes
string-array.item: Knees caving in
Heels lifting off the floor
Leaning far forward

string-array.name: guide_step_up_steps
string-array.item: Stand in front of a knee-high box with dumbbells at your sides.
Place one whole foot on the box.
Step up by straightening the leg on the box without pushing off the lower one.
Step down slowly and repeat.

string-array.name: guide_step_up_mistakes
string-array.item: Pushing off with the bottom leg
Knee caving in
Using a box that is too high

string-array.name: guide_wall_sit_steps
string-array.item: Lean your back against a wall with feet shoulder-width apart and slightly forward.
Slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees over your feet and your back on the wall.
Hold for the set time.

string-array.name: guide_wall_sit_mistakes
string-array.item: Knees far past the toes
Pushing on the thighs with your hands
Holding your breath

string-array.name: guide_smith_squat_steps
string-array.item: Step under the bar, rest it on your traps and place your feet slightly in front of it.
Unhook the bar by turning your wrists.
Squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor with a straight back.
Stand up without snapping the knees straight.

string-array.name: guide_smith_squat_mistakes
string-array.item: Feet directly under the bar, overloading the knees
Lower back rounding at the bottom
Knees caving in

string-array.name: guide_box_jump_steps
string-array.item: Stand half a step from a stable box.
Dip slightly and swing your arms back.
Jump up with an arm swing and land softly on the box with whole feet.
Stand tall on top and step down.

string-array.name: guide_box_jump_mistakes
string-array.item: Landing stiff-legged
Jumping back down instead of stepping
Using a box that is too high

string-array.name: guide_seated_leg_curl_steps
string-array.item: Sit with your knees aligned to the machine pivot and the pad above your ankles.
Lock your thighs under the top pad.
Curl your legs, pulling your heels under the seat.
Straighten them slowly.

string-array.name: guide_seated_leg_curl_mistakes
string-array.item: Hips lifting off the seat
Jerking
Not straightening fully

string-array.name: guide_nordic_curl_steps
string-array.item: Kneel on a soft pad with your heels locked under a support or held by a partner.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lean forward slowly, resisting with your hamstrings.
Catch yourself with your hands and push back up.

string-array.name: guide_nordic_curl_mistakes
string-array.item: Bending at the hips
Falling without control
Moving too fast

string-array.name: guide_dumbbell_romanian_deadlift_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall with the dumbbells in front of your thighs and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs.
Lower until the hamstrings stretch hard, keeping your back straight.
Return by driving your hips forward.

string-array.name: guide_dumbbell_romanian_deadlift_mistakes
string-array.item: Rounding the back
Squatting instead of hinging
Dumbbells drifting away from the legs

string-array.name: guide_stability_ball_leg_curl_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with your heels on the ball and arms by your sides.
Lift your hips until your body is straight.
Roll the ball in by bending your knees while keeping the hips up.
Roll it back out slowly.

string-array.name: guide_stability_ball_leg_curl_mistakes
string-array.item: Hips dropping during the move
Jerking
Ball rolling sideways

string-array.name: guide_kettlebell_swing_steps
string-array.item: Stand a bit wider than shoulders with the kettlebell on the floor ahead.
Hinge back and hike the bell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward so the bell floats to chest height.
Let it swing back between your legs with the same hinge.

string-array.name: guide_kettlebell_swing_mistakes
string-array.item: Lifting the bell with the arms
Squatting instead of hinging
Rounding the back

string-array.name: guide_hip_abduction_machine_steps
string-array.item: Sit with your back on the pad and the pads outside your knees.
Hold the handles and keep your torso still.
Push your legs apart as far as they go.
Bring them together slowly without letting the weight bang.

string-array.name: guide_hip_abduction_machine_mistakes
string-array.item: Jerking and momentum
Rocking the torso
Short range of motion

string-array.name: guide_sumo_deadlift_steps
string-array.item: Set your feet wide with toes turned out and the bar over mid-foot.
Grip the bar narrow between your legs, back straight, chest up.
Stand up pushing your knees out and extending the hips.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back.

string-array.name: guide_sumo_deadlift_mistakes
string-array.item: Knees caving in
Rounding the back
Bar drifting away from the legs

string-array.name: guide_cable_pull_through_steps
string-array.item: Stand with your back to a low pulley, rope between your legs, and step forward a couple of paces.
Hinge back, letting your arms reach between your legs.
Stand up by driving your hips forward with the glutes.
Squeeze at the top and hinge back down.

string-array.name: guide_cable_pull_through_mistakes
string-array.item: Pulling with the arms
Arching the lower back at the top
Squatting instead of hinging

string-array.name: guide_leg_press_calf_raise_steps
string-array.item: Sit in the leg press with the balls of your feet on the lower edge of the platform.
Straighten your legs without locking the knees.
Let your heels drop until the calves stretch.
Push the platform up with your toes as far as you can.

string-array.name: guide_leg_press_calf_raise_mistakes
string-array.item: Bending the knees during the move
Bouncing through a short range
Feet slipping off the platform

string-array.name: guide_single_leg_calf_raise_steps
string-array.item: Stand on the edge of a step on one foot with a dumbbell in the same hand, holding a support with the other.
Lower your heel below the step.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause for a second and lower slowly.

string-array.name: guide_single_leg_calf_raise_mistakes
string-array.item: Bouncing without a pause
Bending the knee
Partial range of motion

string-array.name: guide_side_plank_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your side propped on your forearm, elbow under the shoulder.
Stack your feet or place one in front of the other.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Hold for the set time, then switch sides.

string-array.name: guide_side_plank_mistakes
string-array.item: Hips sagging
Hips drifting back
Shoulder creeping up to the ear

string-array.name: guide_bicycle_crunch_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and legs raised and bent.
Twist, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Straighten the other leg at the same time.
Switch sides slowly and under control.

string-array.name: guide_bicycle_crunch_mistakes
string-array.item: Pulling on the head
Moving too fast
Lower back lifting off the floor

string-array.name: guide_lying_leg_raise_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with your hands by your sides or under your glutes.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your straight legs to vertical.
Lower them slowly without touching the floor or arching your back.

string-array.name: guide_lying_leg_raise_mistakes
string-array.item: Lower back arching
Kicking the legs up
Dropping the legs

string-array.name: guide_dead_bug_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back, arms up, hips and knees bent at 90°.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Slowly lower the opposite arm and leg almost to the floor.
Bring them back and switch sides.

string-array.name: guide_dead_bug_mistakes
string-array.item: Lower back lifting off the floor
Moving too fast
Holding your breath

string-array.name: guide_pallof_press_steps
string-array.item: Stand side-on to a chest-height pulley holding the handle at your chest with both hands.
Step out until the cable is taut, feet shoulder-width apart.
Press the handle forward without letting your torso turn toward the stack.
Hold, then bring it back to your chest.

string-array.name: guide_pallof_press_mistakes
string-array.item: Torso rotating toward the stack
Shoulders creeping up
Going too heavy

string-array.name: guide_swimming_steps
string-array.item: Warm up on land and swim the first length easy.
Keep your body horizontal with your head in line with your spine.
Exhale into the water and inhale as you turn your head.
Hold an even pace for the whole distance.

string-array.name: guide_swimming_mistakes
string-array.item: Holding your breath
Head too high so the legs sink
Starting too fast

string-array.name: guide_walking_steps
string-array.item: Walk at a brisk pace where you can talk but not sing.
Keep your back straight and swing your arms with your steps.
Land on your heel and roll through to your toes.
Add incline on a treadmill for more load.

string-array.name: guide_walking_mistakes
string-array.item: Holding the treadmill rails
Slouching
Sessions that are too short

string-array.name: guide_burpee_steps
string-array.item: From standing, squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a plank and do a push-up.
Jump your feet back to your hands.
Jump up and clap overhead.

string-array.name: guide_burpee_mistakes
string-array.item: Hips sagging in the plank
Landing hard
Rounding the back when squatting

string-array.name: guide_air_bike_steps
string-array.item: Set the seat so your leg is almost straight at the bottom.
Push and pull with your arms while you pedal.
Keep your back straight without slumping onto the handles.
Alternate intervals and rest or hold a steady pace.

string-array.name: guide_air_bike_mistakes
string-array.item: Seat set too low
Using the legs only
Going out too fast and fading at the end
